translations.web: Now when they fall, they will be helped with a little help; but many will join themselves to them with flatteries.
translations.bsb: Now when they fall, they will be granted a little help, but many will join them insincerely.
translations.kjv: Now when they shall fall, they shall be holpen with a little help: but many shall cleave to them with flatteries.
